body:
Delivered the complete independent entity-history B02 scientific review for the fixed task at 10450ff03b3a340fbc98c63ed80fcff57b92596e.

[Read the complete review at delivery commit b4a67c7bf7b0eec726f107bf7acdf148f7e60109](https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/b4a67c7bf7b0eec726f107bf7acdf148f7e60109/docs/research/candidates/vap_folr_core/pro_packets/20260914_entity_history_b02_review/archive/RESPONSE.md).

All 93 lines, including references, were read back at that commit. Comparison against pre-write HEAD a89a2c65b03b6709836912211b55a3fb74a5ab12 confirms one commit adding only the authorized RESPONSE.md on codex/vap-folr.

The review finds no material scientific defect in the documented B02 comparison or frozen GENERIC_ABOVE_MEI reading. It distinguishes the completed first fresh-learning contrast from unresolved training variation, assesses the strongest second-block alternative, and asks the DM to respond to the remaining qualitative research-value challenge. It preserves E's unavailable primary, F's fixed-reference scope, earlier H/outcomes and all claim limits. The review does not decide lifecycle, funding or execution.

No source, DIRECTION, control/Portfolio file, prior response or other branch was changed. No scientific code, checkpoint load, raw-result reanalysis, test or experiment was executed.
